transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, for the last couple of years, I just feel low all the time. It doesn't really matter what I'm doing. Even when I'm at work checking things on the line, or at church, or around people I care about, there's just this heavy, empty feeling. And it... it just doesn't really lift.
During these past two years, has there ever been a time when you felt like your normal self for more than two months?

No, I don't think so. There hasn't been a break like that. I mean, I might have an okay day here or there, but... no, definitely not for two whole months. It's just been pretty much constant this whole time.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions or physical health problems?
No, I haven't. Um, physically I'm fine. I haven't been diagnosed with anything like that.
During these past two years, has there been a time when your symptoms became noticeably worse for a couple of weeks or more?

Um, no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed it spiking or getting a lot worse for a few weeks at a time. It's just... it's really just a steady kind of low. It pretty much stays exactly the same.
Have you ever experienced a period of time when you felt the complete opposite—unusually energized, elated, or like your thoughts were racing and you needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I haven't ever experienced that. Um, I've never felt unusually energized or elated like you're describing. And I definitely haven't had racing thoughts or felt like I didn't need sleep. It's really just been the exact opposite.
